observations.why: The speaker enacts a decisional stance — declaring a switch rather than proposing one — performing authority over the technology choice.
The justification is framed entirely in proportional cost-benefit terms — performance multiplier and price reduction — the classic market-pricing ratio framing.
A formatted decision record entry enacting the migration as decided — the structured heading form performs authoritative determination, not proposal.
The performance gain is recorded as a proportional multiplier — a cost-benefit ratio that frames the decision in market-pricing terms.
Setting a timeline is an authoritative allocation act — the principal fixes a temporal commitment for the organization, enacting rank-based determination.
